column3: Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies the object “the LORD” after “I love.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in my days” is rendered “as long as I live,” and NKJV supplies “Him.”
Close to the Hebrew; חֶבְלֵי־ (“the cords”) is rendered “The pains,” and “distresses” “the pangs.”
Close to the Hebrew; the plural לִמְנוּחָיְכִי (“your resting places”) is rendered “your rest.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I believed, for I spoke” is rendered “I believed, therefore I spoke.”
Close to the Hebrew; the plural “salvations” is rendered “salvation.”
Close to the Hebrew; לַחֲסִידָיו (“his godly ones”) is rendered “His saints.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Hallelujah” is rendered “Praise the LORD!”
